reason: I buy to resell, so I count the landed cost per piece. 13,000 a kilo by air plus 8% plus delivery makes every piece cost more than what I can find in Shorja, and there is nothing here for someone ordering in quantity.
objection: The fees are built for one person buying one pair of shoes, not for a shop. At 21,000 IQD on a 30,000 item, my margin is gone before I put it on the shelf, and I have no proof yet that the dates will hold for my stock.
would_change_my_mind: A wholesale rate for bulk orders from 1688: a lower price per kilo for big shipments and a lower buying fee, with a guaranteed delivery date.
